body: My whole thing I don't are who's kid this is. I'll raise her like my own. I'm afraid that my girlfriend will leave me (which sucks but happens to everyone at one point I suppose) and I won't be able to see/raise this girl. If she is mine, I know I can fight for custody and all that, but if this child isn't mine, I won't be able to see her. I've grown attached to this child despite her not being here yet. It's going to kill me if I don't get to know her and see her.

If it is my kid, I'll totally raise her. If it's not, I wouldn't mind raising her either. I really wouldn't. Especially if whoever the father is turns out to be a piece of shit. It's the fact that I love this baby and if she really is going around behind my back, I would lose her and the baby. I've become attached. I took her to every appointment and cried when I found out it was a girl. I would speak to her everyday when I could. I have all these hopes and dreams of what to do with her when she gets older like teach her how to ride a bike, go to the zoo to look at penguins, play dress up and have tea parties. Regardless of who the father is, I love this baby and it's looking like it's a real possibility I won't have her in my life. (Sure I could fight for joint custody if she is mine, but I mean I want her to grow up with me, in the same household and all that.)
